business_summary: Haiyang Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of nylon 6 series products in China and internationally. It also offers Nylon6 yarn and chips; tyre cord fabric; and high-tenacity yarn. The company was founded in 1970 and is based in Taizhou, China.
